props.name: defaultSelected

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant of the component. `primary` is the default style with shadow. `secondary` is a lower emphasis variant without shadow, suitable for use in surfaces.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element, used when submitting an HTML form

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the input element, used when submitting an HTML form

props.name: onChange
props.description: Handler called when the checkbox value changes

props.name: render
props.description: Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
